name: Trinidad and Tobago
shortSummary: Trinidad and Tobago is home to one of the world's largest Indo-Caribbean communities (roughly 35-40% of the population traces Indian descent), anchoring India's closest relationship in the Caribbean.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: A large population of Indian descent, dating to 19th-century indentured labour migration, drives exceptionally deep cultural ties.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
